sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "matches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lifecycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "recording_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'simple', "tracking_coverage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scoresOnly', "rule_template_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "timer_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("timer_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (lifecycle IN ('draft', 'active', 'finished', 'archived', 'abandoned')), CHECK (recording_mode IN ('simple', 'detailed')), CHECK (tracking_coverage IN ('none', 'scoresOnly', 'shotAttempts', 'locations', 'full')));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "players" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preferred_side" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_a_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_b_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "slot_a_player_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "slot_b_player_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "lifecycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "next_game_number" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "default_setup_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "lifecycle_intents_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (lifecycle IN ('open', 'closed')), CHECK (next_game_number > 0 AND revision >= 0), CHECK (length(trim(slot_a_name)) > 0 AND length(trim(slot_b_name)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_matches" ("match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES match_series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "game_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "slot_a_side" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("match_id"), UNIQUE (series_id, game_number), CHECK (game_number > 0), CHECK (slot_a_side IN ('red', 'blue')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_participants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "player_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (side IN ('red', 'blue')), CHECK (length(trim(name_snapshot)) > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_clocks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'countUp', "phase" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'regulation', "accumulated_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "running_since_utc" INTEGER NULL, "regulation_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (mode IN ('countUp', 'countdown')), CHECK (phase IN ('regulation', 'regulationExpired', 'overtime')), CHECK (accumulated_seconds >= 0), CHECK (regulation_seconds IS NULL OR regulation_seconds >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "claimed_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 'active'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "side" TEXT NULL, "points" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "match_clock_position_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "custom_label" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('score', 'fieldGoal', 'freeThrow', 'miss', 'foul', 'reward', 'pause', 'interruption', 'note', 'custom', 'possession')), CHECK (side IS NULL OR side IN ('red', 'blue')), CHECK (type NOT IN ('score', 'fieldGoal', 'freeThrow') OR side IS NOT NULL), CHECK (type != 'score' OR (side IS NOT NULL AND points > 0)), CHECK (type != 'freeThrow' OR (outcome IS NOT NULL AND ((outcome = 'made' AND points > 0) OR (outcome = 'missed' AND points = 0)))), CHECK (type != 'fieldGoal' OR (outcome IS NOT NULL AND ((outcome = 'made' AND points > 0) OR (outcome = 'missed' AND points = 0)))), CHECK (type != 'miss' OR (side IS NOT NULL AND points = 0)), CHECK (outcome IS NULL OR outcome IN ('made', 'missed', 'notApplicable')), CHECK (match_clock_position_seconds IS NULL OR match_clock_position_seconds >= 0), CHECK (points >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shot_locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES match_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "x" REAL NOT NULL, "y" REAL NOT NULL, "is_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_confirmed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (x >= 0 AND x <= 1 AND y >= 0 AND y <= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rule_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "score_buttons_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_score" INTEGER NULL, "time_limit_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "win_by_two" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("win_by_two" IN (0, 1)), "foul_limit" INTEGER NULL, "custom_event_types_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_built_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_built_in" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "possession_segments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "side" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES match_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ended_at_event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES match_events (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (side IN ('red', 'blue')), CHECK (source IN ('manual', 'suggested')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "player_analytics_snapshots" ("match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "player_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "opponent_player_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES players (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "played_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "player_score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opponent_score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "field_goal_made" INTEGER NOT NULL, "field_goal_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "free_throw_made" INTEGER NOT NULL, "free_throw_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tracking_coverage" TEXT NOT NULL, "confirmed_location_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locatable_location_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "zone_distribution_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "calculator_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("match_id", "player_id"), CHECK (tracking_coverage IN ('none', 'scoresOnly', 'shotAttempts', 'locations', 'full')), CHECK (player_score >= 0 AND opponent_score >= 0), CHECK (field_goal_made >= 0 AND field_goal_attempts >= field_goal_made), CHECK (free_throw_made >= 0 AND free_throw_attempts >= free_throw_made), CHECK (confirmed_location_count >= 0 AND locatable_location_count >= confirmed_location_count), CHECK (length(source_sha256) = 64));
